changes: Android returns to River after device linking and Matrix approval, and resumes pending sign-in if the app restarts.
Fix accepting conversation invitations and removing members through Matrix; use each person's full Matrix identity.
Open newly created rooms after their Matrix state arrives, without mixing messages from the previous room.
Keep separate drafts and pending attachments for each conversation, and retry failed sends without duplicating messages.
Reconnect the saved Matrix device after an offline restore and keep messages visible when the member list is unavailable.
